sql:
select
  entity_table,
  count(distinct tenant_id) as tenants_with_policy,
  round(100.0 * count(distinct tenant_id) / 120, 1) as pct_tenants_with_policy,
  round(avg(retention_days), 1) as avg_retention_days,
  min(retention_days) as min_retention_days,
  max(retention_days) as max_retention_days,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when is_active then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 1) as pct_policies_active,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when last_run_at >= date '2025-10-03' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 1) as pct_policies_run_in_last_90_days
from retention_policies
where entity_table in ('audit_log', 'access_log', 'change_history', 'data_subject_requests', 'compliance_events', 'login_attempts')
group by entity_table
order by entity_table
note: One row per entity_table as requested, aggregated across all tenants' retention_policies rows; a table only appears here if at least one tenant has defined a policy row for it, so missing rows in the printed report (expect up to 6) mean zero tenants have ever configured a policy for that table.
